name: MiniCPM-OCR gets native vLLM and SGLang support
title: MiniCPM-OCR gets native vLLM and SGLang support
summary: OpenBMB says its MiniCPM-OCR model now runs natively in vLLM and SGLang, so developers can serve it with either framework without custom integration. No benchmark or repo link in the post.
